digest.component_or_area: external-integration live-tier tests / plan-review DET floor
propositions: The live_single_turn workflow returns status 'failed' and coverage.llm_ran is False in the external live-services CI job.

test_single_turn_live_structured_output fails because the test writes the live-verdict prompt into the working tree without committing it, so the attested HEAD snapshot lacks the prompt and get_prompt raises unknown prompt 'live-verdict'.

test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict fails because the fixture plan omits a Testing/Verification section, tripping the blocking p10_verification_presence DET floor which short-circuits to BLOCK without calling the LLM.
The provider/model seam is ruled out: with the DET short-circuit removed the tier reaches Anthropic and only 401s on a deliberately-invalid key.
The failures were previously masked by SnapshotRefError (bug 8070) and are pre-existing dead guards, not a regression from commit b7e6ac963.
Fix is test-side: conftest commits the prompt override and adds a Testing section to the fixture, plus a credential-free default-tier reachability guard.
